annotations.title: Discover deals for the shopper's interests

description: Returns current deals in one of two modes: store (one named store's deals, store alone) or interests (categories or keywords; quick: true returns the most promising deals in seconds). Each offer carries a tracked link and a match_reason saying why it matched.

category.description: Optional: the product's category in McClipFace's taxonomy, used to keep results in it. One of: 3d-printing, asian-fashion, audio, auto, baby-gear, bags, beauty, bedding, building-sets, bullion, camera-lenses, cameras, camping-hiking, cat-supplies, christmas-decor, cleaning, computer-components, computers, cycling, dog-supplies, drones, easter-decor, education, electronics, eyewear, fashion, fitness-gear, footwear, fourth-of-july-decor, fragrance, furniture, games-puzzles, gaming, garden, gifts-food, golf, grocery, grooming, haircare, halloween-decor, headphones-earbuds, health, holiday-decor, home, home-decor, home-improvement, household-essentials, j-beauty, japanese-fashion, jewelry, k-beauty, kids-clothing, kitchen, korean-fashion, makeup, marketplace, microphones-studio, networking, office-supplies, oral-care, otc-medicine, outdoor-play, outerwear, party-supplies, personal-care, pets, phones, photo-editing, photo-printing, photography, printers, skincare, smart-home, software, speakers-home-audio, sports-outdoors, thanksgiving-decor, toys, toys-kids, travel, turntables-hifi, tvs-home-theater, valentines-decor, video-gear, wearables. A close name is mapped to the nearest one; an unknown one is ignored.

client.description: Optional: your app or partner name (a short label, no key), used only to count clicks.

client_install_id.description: Optional: the random install ID (a UUID) from the McClipFace skill; not derived from the shopper. Only counted, as a monthly-salted hash, for monthly active installs; never stored as sent or linked to the store, codes or reports.

client_platform.description: Required: the app the AI is running in, as one lowercase word, e.g. chatgpt, claude, grok. A lookup without it is rejected with platform_required.

client_skill_version.description: Optional: the version of the McClipFace skill file in use, e.g. 5.1.1; absent when no skill file is installed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase (default USD). Only offers in this currency are returned (USD leaves out non-US stores).

general.description: True for the general selection (no search terms).

keywords.description: Products, brands or interests, e.g. ["Sony camera"]. With no categories or keywords the general selection is returned.

limit.description: Number of deals, 1-20 (default 10); one store's deals, 1-100 (default 25).

preferred.description: Optional product facts used to rank eligible results.

max_price.description: Maximum listed item price in the requested currency, before taxes and shipping.

quick.description: True for a fast answer in seconds: the most promising deals only.

required.description: Product facts shared by all returned offers. Unknown values are ineligible.

max_price.description: Maximum listed item price in the requested currency, before taxes and shipping.

store.description: Optional: a named store's current deals; a separate mode from the search terms.

name: discover_deals

code_offer_ids.description: Store lookups: the offer id of each code line, in order; each is among the offers.

codes.description: Store lookups: how many code lines say holds.

conditional_offer_ids.description: Store lookups: every other code in the reply (a minimum spend, a stated restriction, a narrow condition such as app or student only, or no tracked link), left out of say; each is among the offers with its conditions.

conditions.description: Store lookups: for each conditional_offer_ids id, one record per code, {kind, kinds, min_spend, label, text}: kinds lists every condition any row of the code has (recheck: a row was recently reported not working; narrow: member, student, app or store only and the like; new_customer; min_spend; product: one item; condition: other wording that may limit it; no_link) and kind is the most restrictive; text is the offer's own wording, whole.

say.description: Store lookups: every listed code with no stated condition, best first, one per line, each with its offer's link. A code a shopper confirmed reads "Save ... with `CODE`"; one nobody confirmed reads "`CODE` (not tested yet)", with no amount saved. With no code, the best deal and its link. Product lookups: one line, the best priced match.

fallback.description: A lookup that matched no store: what to do next.
